بُنِّىٌّ A seller of بُنّ [or coffee-berries]. (TA.) ＝
-A2- Also, [vulgarly pronounced بِنِّى,] A species of fish; (K;) [the cyprinus Bynni of Forskål; described by him in his Descr. Anim. p. 71;] it is white, and is the best kind [of fish], and abundant in the Nile. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
